_comment: v12.2 companions (约人) and table events (饭桌上说的话). places: who may come to each place and what their company is good for (the perks are rules in index.html, keyed by place and person). events: two- or three-choice talks that can only happen with that person at the table; one per meal at most, a chance per place (chance), seeded by week, day and person, each event once per career. Text is { zh, en }. Choice: [text, fx, minutes, feedback]. fx as everywhere; trust goes to the companion.

perk.zh: 下一段写作一开始就有专注
perk.en: your next writing block starts in flow

perk.zh: 合作信 +1 星（每周一次）
perk.en: +1 star on the collaboration letter (once a week)

perk.zh: 院办的事她帮你理顺（补一张报销手续，或院办事项多 1 小时）
perk.en: she smooths the office side (one reimbursement fixed, or an hour more on office tasks)

title.zh: 小陈：我是不是不适合做科研
title.en: Chen: maybe I'm not cut out for research

open.zh: 小陈戳着碗里的面，半天没动筷子。|小陈：老师，我同学已经三篇一作了。我做了一年半，一个拟合都没对过。我是不是不适合做科研？
open.en: Chen pokes at his noodles without eating.|小陈：Prof, my classmate already has three first-author papers. A year and a half in, I haven't got one fit right. Maybe I'm not cut out for this?

ch.zh: 讲讲你自己博士第二年最狼狈的事
ch.en: Tell him about the worst moment of your own second year

ch.zh: 你讲到第一篇论文被拒三次。小陈笑出了声，然后说：“那我再试试。”
ch.en: You get to the part where your first paper was rejected three times. He laughs, then says: "Okay. I'll keep going."

ch.zh: 给他一个两周的小目标：把拟合那一章写完
ch.en: Give him a two-week target: finish the fit chapter

ch.zh: 他把目标写在了手机备忘录里，第一行加了三个感叹号。
ch.en: He types the goal into his phone, with three exclamation marks.

ch.zh: “大家都这样。吃吧，面要凉了。”
ch.en: "Everyone feels that way. Eat, it's getting cold."

ch.zh: 他点点头，低头吃面。后面二十分钟没再说话。
ch.en: He nods and eats. He doesn't say anything for the next twenty minutes.

title.zh: 小陈：昨天给您的拟合可能有个 bug
title.en: Chen: the fit I gave you yesterday may have a bug

open.zh: 小陈放下筷子。|小陈：老师，我昨晚睡前想到，本底那一项我可能算了两遍。那张图……已经放进基金书的预实验部分了吧？
open.en: Chen puts his chopsticks down: Prof, last night I realised I may have counted the background twice. That plot… it's already in the grant's preliminary data, isn't it?

ch.zh: 吃完一起回去查，今天就改
ch.en: Go back together after lunch and fix it today

ch.zh: bug 是真的。改完的曲线没那么漂亮，但每个点都站得住。
ch.en: The bug is real. The corrected curve is less pretty, and every point holds up.

ch.zh: “谢谢你说出来。写清楚，今晚我来核对。”
ch.en: "Thank you for saying so. Write it up; I'll check it tonight."

ch.zh: 晚上十点，你收到一份两页的说明，连修改前后的对比图都画好了。
ch.en: At ten that night a two-page note arrives, with before-and-after plots.

ch.zh: “先别动，等周五截止以后再说”
ch.en: "Leave it until after Friday's deadline"

ch.zh: 小陈说好。你注意到他没再看你的眼睛。
ch.en: He says okay. You notice he stops meeting your eyes.

title.en: Chen: I'd like to present in Japan

open.zh: 小陈把手机推过来。|小陈：下个月京都有个缪子物理会议，摘要还能投。|小陈：我想讲寿命测量。您觉得……够格吗？
open.en: Chen slides his phone across: a muon physics meeting in Kyoto next month, abstracts still open.|小陈：I'd like to talk about the lifetime measurement. Is it… good enough?

ch.zh: 投口头报告，周四我帮你过一遍幻灯片
ch.en: Submit for a talk; you'll go through his slides on Thursday

ch.zh: 他当场就打开了投稿系统。
ch.en: He opens the submission page right there at the table.

ch.zh: 今年先投海报，经费留给新探测器
ch.en: A poster this year; the money goes to the new detector

ch.zh: “好的老师。”他把手机收了回去。
ch.en: "Okay, Prof." He puts the phone away.

ch.zh: “等基金结果出来再说”
ch.en: "Let's wait for the grant result"

ch.zh: 摘要截止在基金结果出来之前。你们都知道。
ch.en: The abstract deadline is before the grant result. You both know it.

title.en: Zhou: I might not do a PhD

open.zh: 小周把餐盘推到一边。|小周：老师……我可能不读博了。|小周：推荐信您都写了一半了，对不起。我就是越来越不确定，自己是喜欢物理，还是只是习惯了考第一。
open.en: Zhou pushes her tray aside: Prof… I might not do a PhD after all.|小周：You're halfway through my letter, I'm sorry. I'm just less and less sure whether I love physics or I'm just used to coming first.

ch.zh: “先别急着决定。下学期来组里做一个真课题，再看”
ch.en: "Don't decide yet. Do a real project with us next term, then see"

ch.zh: 她想了很久，说：“那我试一个学期。”
ch.en: She thinks for a long time: "One term, then."

ch.zh: “这是你的决定。不管去哪，推荐信我都照样写好”
ch.en: "It's your call. Wherever you go, I'll write the letter just as well"

ch.zh: 她眼圈红了一下：“谢谢老师。”
ch.en: Her eyes go red for a second. "Thank you."

ch.zh: 岔开话题：“这周食堂的秘鲁菜你吃了吗？”
ch.en: Change the subject: "Have you tried the Peruvian stall this week?"

ch.zh: 她笑了笑，没再提。
ch.en: She smiles and doesn't bring it up again.

title.zh: 小周：推荐信能不能写“厉害”一点
title.en: Zhou: could the letter sound a bit stronger?

open.zh: 小周有点不好意思。|小周：老师，推荐信里能不能写是我“主导”了那个探测器项目？|小周：师姐说国外的信都写得很夸张，不夸张就等于差。
open.en: Zhou, a little embarrassed: Prof, could the letter say I "led" the detector project?|小周：A senior said letters abroad are all inflated, and an honest one reads as weak.

ch.zh: 照实写，但写具体：她做了哪几件别人做不到的事
ch.en: Write it straight but specific: the things she did that others couldn't

ch.zh: 你举了她半夜修好读出板的例子。具体的事比形容词有分量。
ch.en: You describe the night she fixed the readout board. Specifics outweigh adjectives.

ch.zh: 让她先起草一份事实清单，你来改
ch.en: Ask her for a list of facts first; you'll edit

ch.zh: 她的清单比你记得的还多三条。
ch.en: Her list has three things you had forgotten.

ch.zh: 按她说的写
ch.en: Write it the way she asks

ch.zh: 信发出去了。你希望项目合作者里没有人认识收信的教授。
ch.en: The letter goes out. You hope none of the collaborators knows the professor reading it.

title.zh: 小周：我爸妈想让我考公
title.en: Zhou: my parents want me to sit the civil service exam

open.zh: 小周：昨晚我爸妈又打电话了，说读博太辛苦，让我考公务员，稳定。|小周：我不知道怎么跟他们说。
open.en: 小周：My parents called again last night. A PhD is too hard, they say; sit the civil service exam, it's stable.|小周：I don't know how to talk to them.

ch.zh: “要不要我和你爸妈视频聊一次？”
ch.en: "Would it help if I had a video call with your parents?"

ch.zh: 视频里她爸爸问了二十分钟奖学金和就业。最后说：“老师，那就拜托您了。”
ch.en: Her father asks about stipends and jobs for twenty minutes, then says: "We'll leave her in your hands."

ch.zh: 把两条路的事实都摆出来：收入、时间、能做什么
ch.en: Lay out the facts of both paths: pay, time, what each lets her do

ch.zh: 她拍下你在餐巾纸上画的表。
ch.en: She takes a photo of the table you drew on a napkin.

ch.zh: “父母一般都是为你好”
ch.en: "Parents usually know best"

ch.zh: 她点点头，说：“嗯，我再想想。”
ch.en: She nods. "Mm. I'll think about it."

title.zh: 小雨：我这两周每天只睡四个小时
title.en: Yu: I've slept four hours a night for two weeks

open.zh: 小雨端着饭，眼下一片青。|小雨：老师，我这两周每天只睡四个小时，论文还是写不完。|小雨：我是不是太慢了？
open.en: Yu holds her tray; there are dark rings under her eyes: Prof, I've slept four hours a night for two weeks and the thesis still isn't done.|小雨：Am I just too slow?

ch.zh: “今晚九点前回宿舍。这是导师的要求。”然后一起排个现实的进度
ch.en: "Back to your room by nine tonight. That's an instruction." Then plan a realistic schedule together

ch.zh: 新进度表把答辩前的三周拉成了五周。她松了一口气。
ch.en: The new plan stretches three weeks to five. She breathes out.

ch.zh: 陪她去学校的心理咨询中心预约，一起走过去
ch.en: Walk her over to the university counselling centre to book a session

ch.zh: 预约排在周四。走回来的路上她说：“谢谢您没觉得我矫情。”
ch.en: The appointment is Thursday. On the way back she says: "Thanks for not thinking I'm being dramatic."

ch.zh: “写论文的季节，大家都这样”
ch.en: "It's thesis season, everyone's like this"

ch.zh: 她笑了一下，把剩下的饭倒掉了。
ch.en: She smiles and throws the rest of her food away.

title.zh: 小雨：师兄把我的图用进了他的报告
title.en: Yu: a senior student used my figure in his talk

open.zh: 小雨小声说。|小雨：老师，上周学院报告会上，隔壁组的师兄用了我做的效率图，没写我的名字。|小雨：我不想闹大，但心里不舒服。
open.en: Yu, quietly: Prof, at last week's department seminar a senior from the next group showed my efficiency plot without my name.|小雨：I don't want to make a fuss, but it bothers me.

ch.zh: 周一组会上立个规矩：用别人的图，写上名字
ch.en: Make it a rule at Monday's group meeting: use someone's figure, credit them

ch.zh: 规矩写进了组里的 wiki 首页。小雨的名字后来出现在三张幻灯片上。
ch.en: The rule goes on the group wiki's front page. Yu's name later appears on three slides.

ch.zh: 私下找那位师兄和他导师聊聊
ch.en: Have a private word with the senior and his supervisor

ch.zh: 对方道了歉。隔壁组的老师有点尴尬，你也是。
ch.en: He apologises. His supervisor is a bit embarrassed. So are you.

ch.zh: “一个楼里的，算了”
ch.en: "Same building. Let it go"

ch.zh: 她说好。下一次组会，她的图没再放进共享文件夹。
ch.en: She says fine. At the next group meeting her plots are no longer in the shared folder.

title.zh: 小雨：我想去企业实习三个月
title.en: Yu: I'd like a three-month industry internship

open.zh: 小雨：老师，一家做医学影像的公司给了我实习机会，三个月。|小雨：我知道组里缺人……但我想看看外面是什么样。
open.en: 小雨：Prof, a medical imaging company offered me a three-month internship.|小雨：I know the group is short-handed… but I want to see what it's like outside.

ch.zh: 支持，帮她把论文进度和实习错开排好
ch.en: Support it, and help her fit the thesis schedule around it

ch.zh: 她把实习推迟了一个月，两边都排得开。
ch.en: She moves the start back a month, and both fit.

ch.zh: “答辩完再去，到时我帮你写推荐”
ch.en: "After your defence, and I'll write you a reference"

ch.zh: 她想了想：“也行。”
ch.en: She thinks it over. "That works."

ch.zh: “现在不行，探测器离不开人”
ch.en: "Not now. The detector can't spare anyone"

ch.zh: 她回了公司一封婉拒信，抄送了你。
ch.en: She declines the offer by email, and copies you.

title.zh: 小林：上周的气瓶检查我没做
title.en: Lin: I skipped last week's gas cylinder check

open.zh: 小林嚼着饭，突然停住。|小林：老师……上周五的气瓶检查我没做，记录本上是我照着前一周抄的。|小林：后天学院安全检查，我越想越怕。
open.en: Lin stops chewing: Prof… I didn't do last Friday's cylinder check. I copied the week before into the log.|小林：The department inspection is the day after tomorrow and I can't stop thinking about it.

ch.zh: 吃完一起去实验室，现在就查，记录照实改
ch.en: Go to the lab together after lunch, check now, correct the log honestly

ch.zh: 一个减压阀接头有轻微泄漏。检漏液冒了一串小泡。小林脸都白了。
ch.en: One regulator fitting has a slow leak; the soap solution bubbles. Lin goes pale.

ch.zh: 严肃地讲一遍为什么不能抄记录
ch.en: Explain, firmly, why a log is never copied

ch.zh: 他一直点头。下午你看见他一个人去了气瓶间。
ch.en: He nods throughout. In the afternoon you see him go to the cylinder room alone.

ch.zh: “下次注意就行，这次就算了”
ch.en: "Just be careful next time"

ch.zh: 他松了一口气。气瓶间的门一下午都没人开。
ch.en: He looks relieved. Nobody opens the cylinder room all afternoon.

title.zh: 小林：组会上大家说的我都听不懂
title.en: Lin: I don't follow anything at group meetings

open.zh: 小林：老师，组会上师兄师姐说的 TDC、死时间、堆积……我都听不懂，又不敢问。
open.en: 小林：Prof, at group meetings everyone talks about TDCs, dead time, pile-up… I don't understand any of it and I'm afraid to ask.

ch.zh: 每周四和他单独聊二十分钟，什么都可以问
ch.en: Twenty minutes one-to-one every Thursday; any question allowed

ch.zh: 他第一周就带来了一张写满问题的纸。
ch.en: He turns up the first week with a page full of questions.

ch.zh: 让赵博士带他，每天一个术语
ch.en: Pair him with Dr Zhao: one term a day

ch.zh: 赵博士在白板角落开了个“今日术语”。
ch.en: Dr Zhao starts a "term of the day" corner on the whiteboard.

ch.zh: “多看文献就懂了”
ch.en: "Read more papers and it'll come"

ch.zh: 他下载了二十篇文献。第一篇看了三天。
ch.en: He downloads twenty papers. The first one takes him three days.

title.zh: 小林：我想用手机测宇宙线
title.en: Lin: I want to detect cosmic rays with phones

open.zh: 小林眼睛发亮。|小林：老师，我看到手机摄像头能拍到宇宙线的径迹！|小林：开放日我们能不能让中学生用自己的手机测？
open.en: Lin's eyes light up: Prof, phone cameras can catch cosmic-ray tracks!|小林：At open day, could school students measure them with their own phones?

ch.zh: 给他一个周五下午和一点经费，先做个原型
ch.en: Give him a Friday afternoon and a small budget for a prototype

ch.zh: 他找到了 DECO 这类已有的应用，周五下午就测到了第一条径迹。
ch.en: He finds existing apps like DECO, and catches his first track on Friday afternoon.

ch.zh: “好主意，先把这学期的课上完”
ch.en: "Good idea. Finish this term's courses first"

ch.zh: 他把想法记在了本子最后一页。
ch.en: He writes the idea on the last page of his notebook.

ch.zh: “手机那点噪声，测不出什么”
ch.en: "Phone sensors are too noisy for that"

ch.zh: 其实测得出来，只是计数率很低。他没敢反驳。
ch.en: It does work, at a low rate. He doesn't dare say so.

title.zh: 赵博士：有家公司给了我 offer
title.en: Dr Zhao: a company made me an offer

open.zh: 赵博士把筷子并在碗上。|赵博士：老师，一家做缪子成像的公司给了我 offer，工资是现在的两倍半。|赵博士：我还没答应。想先听听您怎么说。
open.en: Dr Zhao lays his chopsticks across the bowl: Prof, a muography company offered me a job at two and a half times my salary.|赵博士：I haven't said yes. I wanted to hear what you think first.

ch.zh: 真心支持，帮他谈个好条件
ch.en: Support him properly, and help him negotiate

ch.zh: 他拿到了更好的期权。走之前，他把探测器的交接文档写了四十页。
ch.en: He gets better equity. Before leaving he writes a forty-page handover for the detector.

ch.zh: 请他再留半年，把探测器论文做完，你帮他发一作
ch.en: Ask him to stay six months to finish the detector paper, as first author

ch.zh: 他想了一晚，回了一句：“行，半年。”
ch.en: He sleeps on it, then replies: "Fine. Six months."

ch.zh: “再说吧，先把这周忙完”
ch.en: "Let's talk later. Let's get through this week"

ch.zh: 他周五就签了。你是从王老师那里知道的。
ch.en: He signs on Friday. You hear it from Ms Wang.

title.zh: 赵博士：能帮我看看教职申请吗
title.en: Dr Zhao: could you read my faculty application?

open.zh: 赵博士：老师，我在申请几所学校的教职，研究陈述写了三版，总觉得不对。|赵博士：您要是有空……
open.en: 赵博士：Prof, I'm applying for faculty jobs. Three drafts of the research statement and it still feels wrong.|赵博士：If you have time…

ch.zh: 今晚逐段批注
ch.en: Annotate it paragraph by paragraph tonight

ch.zh: 批注比原文还长。他回了一句：“我终于知道哪里不对了。”
ch.en: Your comments are longer than the text. He replies: "Now I see what was wrong."

ch.zh: 介绍两位正在招人的同行给他
ch.en: Introduce him to two colleagues who are hiring

ch.zh: 两封介绍邮件，十分钟。其中一位当天就回了。
ch.en: Two introductions, ten minutes. One replies the same day.

ch.zh: “发我吧，周末看”
ch.en: "Send it, I'll look at the weekend"

ch.zh: 周末你打开了它，又关上了。
ch.en: At the weekend you open it, then close it again.

title.zh: 赵博士：带学生太占时间了
title.en: Dr Zhao: supervising takes all my time

open.zh: 赵博士揉着眼睛。|赵博士：老师，小林和小敏每天都来问我问题。我自己的分析这个月几乎没动。
open.en: Dr Zhao rubs his eyes: Prof, Lin and Min come to me with questions every day. My own analysis hasn't moved this month.

ch.zh: 正式让他做小林的副导师，写进他的简历
ch.en: Make him Lin's co-supervisor officially, so it counts on his CV

ch.zh: 他说：“这样带起来有名有分，我愿意。”
ch.en: He says: "With the title it's real work. I'm in."

ch.zh: 每周收回一个学生的例会，自己带
ch.en: Take back one student's weekly meeting yourself

ch.zh: 你的周三下午少了一小时。赵博士的分析图周五就出来了。
ch.en: Your Wednesday afternoon loses an hour. His analysis plot is ready by Friday.

ch.zh: “博士后本来就要带学生”
ch.en: "Supervising is part of a postdoc's job"

ch.zh: 他没再提。之后他回答学生问题越来越短。
ch.en: He drops it. His answers to the students get shorter.

title.zh: 赵博士：院长问我愿不愿意转组
title.en: Dr Zhao: the dean asked if I'd move groups

open.zh: 赵博士压低声音。|赵博士：院长昨天找我，说新引进的那位教授想要个熟悉探测器的博士后，问我愿不愿意过去。
open.en: Dr Zhao lowers his voice: the dean asked me yesterday. The new hire wants a postdoc who knows detectors, and asked if I'd move over.

ch.zh: 告诉他你希望他留下，以及你能给他的
ch.en: Tell him you want him to stay, and what you can offer

ch.zh: 你说了独立的课题和第一作者。他说：“我本来就不想走。”
ch.en: You offer him his own project and first authorship. He says: "I never wanted to leave."

ch.zh: “看哪边对你的发展更好，我都支持”
ch.en: "Whatever's better for your career, I'll back you"

ch.zh: 他说要再想想。
ch.en: He says he'll think about it.

ch.zh: 下午直接去找院长谈
ch.en: Go and talk to the dean this afternoon

ch.zh: 院长笑着说只是随口一问。你们都知道不是。
ch.en: The dean laughs it off as a passing remark. You both know it wasn't.
